_note: Scaffold of shuding/cobe as read 2026-10-14 via gh + npm + README. Nothing installed.

api.createGlobe(canvas, options): returns instance; call .destroy() to remove bindings
api.onRender(state): per-frame callback; mutate state (e.g. state.phi) to animate

dom_binding.mechanism: CSS Anchor Positioning; markers/arcs with an `id` expose anchor names
dom_binding.use: any DOM element can be pinned to a marker; visibility var (0 behind globe, 1 front) drives opacity/blur/scale
dom_binding.verify: CSS anchor-positioning browser support was NOT checked; confirm against caniuse/MDN before relying on it, and design a fallback

surfaces: theme (vanilla, ~19 KB, single canvas, no React; vendor self-hosted into .min build)
frontend/ (works from a useEffect in a 'use client' component)
plausible_uses: brand-story or about section: Oakland origin point plus arcs to ship-to regions
brand_constraints: baseColor/markerColor/glowColor are [r,g,b] 0..1 floats; derive from brand tokens (rose gold #B76E79, gold #D4AF37, silver #C0C0C0, crimson #DC143C, background #0A0A0A), never defaults
Marker coordinates and any location claims come from the founder; do not invent store, studio or shipping locations
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: stop the onRender spin
Own WebGL context: keep off pages already running a three.js scene

gaps: Real marker locations unknown, need founder input
